name: Chocolate Biscuit Wreath Cake
subtitle: A festive ring cake finished with fondant, icing, and gingerbread details.
description: Shape the chocolate biscuit mixture into a wreath, chill until firm, then finish it with fondant, royal icing, colored decorations, and baked gingerbread pieces.

ingredients.item: Christmas chocolate biscuit cake mix (see below)
quantity royal icing plus 3 tbsp (see below)
red and yellow food colouring gels

instructions.text: Brush a 25cm ring mold with sunflower oil. Prepare the Christmas chocolate biscuit cake mix and gingerbread biscuit dough according to their component formulas.
Press the Christmas chocolate biscuit cake mix evenly into the prepared mold, smoothing the surface. Chill until firm.
Preheat the oven to the temperature specified for the gingerbread biscuit dough. Knead the dough briefly, dust the work surface with plain flour, and roll it out.
Cut the rolled dough into decorative shapes and transfer them to a baking sheet. Bake until set, about 8 minutes, then cool completely.
Divide and tint the royal icing with green, red, and yellow food colouring gels as needed for the decorations.
Knead the chocolate fondant icing until pliable. Dust the work surface with icing sugar, roll out the fondant, and use it to cover the chilled wreath cake. Smooth the surface and trim away excess.
Arrange the cooled gingerbread pieces and add the colored royal icing details. Finish with red sugar pearls, then leave the decoration until set before serving.
